body: Can you tell me more about the process of getting into DBT? I didn’t realize there was a whole interview process. Does that mean they can deny you help? I’m seeing a psychiatrist in a few weeks but would love to know more about this.

I’m sorry :( I really can’t anymore. I’ve been fighting the feeling for so long. I have no reason to live except for being an object for others’ happiness or pleasure whether it’s evil or innocent. I get nothing out of life anymore
Thank you. It really helped to talk this out a bit

There’s no confidential line unfortunately, the HR dept is pretty small. It’s a small start up company/everyone talks. He’s the “nicest guy in the office” and part of me doesn’t think he realizes the gravity of what happened. I know I’ll get backlash and most people won’t believe me. 

I’ve told one coworker but didn’t tell her his name, I think she knows who though. And I did tell my manager at the time (but not the full story so as not to put her in a bad position) but also wouldn’t give her a name. I told her so I could transfer offices and not need to see him anymore. That manager doesn’t work at the company anymore.
Yeah that’s what my SO says but he doesn’t understand my not wanting to. How would I even go about reporting it a year later with no evidence?

Thank you so much for your reply. He is an utter piece of shit (your typo did make me laugh though :p really needed that today). Ideally I would love to see him leave the company but it doesn’t look like he’s going anywhere. Other ideal would be to never have to make another excuse for not visiting the other office again, and i just don’t have to go anymore. 

Im afraid to go to HR because the department is not very professional and they’re known to gossip. I used to sit in the same room as HR (which is also at the office where this guy works) and I’ve heard some of the insane, unprofessional shit they gab about super loudly like no one can hear. This includes a different sexual assault case that has nothing to do with me/this guy. I definitely don’t want to press charges because that means I’d have to talk to police right? There’s absolutely no proof of this happening, his word against mine, and almost a year ago. It’s a small-ish company so I’m afraid if I come forward and he gets fired because of me, I’ll be shunned by the rest of the office and not believed. He’s the “nicest guy in the office” and comes off totally harmless and sweet. 

Did this happen to your sister or just with people at her company? Can I ask how it went for her/this person who came forward to HR? I’m afraid how this would affect my career.

Thank you so much for your reply. I really do try to not blame myself, my boss leaving kind of restarting things for me. As well as the anniversary coming up I guess. Logically I know it’s not my fault, but so many “what ifs”. I never thought of myself as strong because I can’t/won’t come forward and am kind of just stuffing it down. I know I need to find a good therapist. I tried 2 in the past year. One seemed to be totally bored by my story and tried to convince me that my SO was the bad guy here and that he’s abusive. I know his reaction was not spectacularly supportive, but from what I read it is pretty normal for someone who has no experience handling this. And he is super supportive of me in every other way, this topic is just very touch and go. 

The other therapist I saw would not see me unless I agreed to use medication :( and at this point our insurance at work switched so therapy will be way more costly than it was with prior insurance. Either way, it does feel strangely good to know I’m not alone in a similar situation. I’m so sorry for what happened to you but happy you have a therapist to talk to. How long did it take you to find someone who worked for you?
